faq.title: Frequent Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before we start working together.
faq.q1: How long does it take to build a website?
faq.a1: It depends on the complexity of the project. A simple landing page usually takes 1-2 weeks, while a more complex webshop or custom system can take 4-8 weeks.
faq.q2: How much does a website cost?
faq.a2: Every project is unique, so pricing varies. Request a free consultation where we assess your needs and provide an exact quote. No hidden costs.
faq.q3: Do you help with domain and hosting?
faq.a3: Absolutely! We handle everything, you just have to approve the names.
faq.a4: Yes, we always work with a 'mobile-first' approach. Your website will look perfect on phones, tablets, and monitors.
faq.q5: Do I need to pay a deposit?
faq.a5: We usually request a 40% deposit before starting work, and the remainder upon delivery when you are fully satisfied with the result.
